source.authority: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory Solar System Dynamics

goal_text: Using the authoritative JSON source https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api?sstr=Eros&full-prec=true, extract JSON path orbit.elements.6.value and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_ASTRONOMY_EROS_A.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api?sstr=Eros&full-prec=true, extract JSON path orbit.elements.7.value and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_ASTRONOMY_EROS_PERIOD.json. Calculate the Kepler predicted orbital period in days using P_pred_days = 365.2568983 * (a_au ** 1.5). Determine whether the predicted and JPL periods differ by at most 2 days. Save the verified result with source provenance and model_dependency_count 0 to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_ASTRONOMY_EROS_KEPLER_RESULT.json.

independent_oracle.method: Re-fetch the exact JPL SBDB URL outside the Brain producer, independently extract a and period by element name rather than array index, recompute P_pred_days using Python math, recompute absolute delta and agreement, and compare consequential fields.
